commit.message: perf(0.4.41): remove redundant Next runtime and compare image builds

files.patch:
@@ -33,12 +33,41 @@ jobs:
           path: upstream
           persist-credentials: false
       - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4.4.1
-      - name: Build image
+      - name: Build upstream 0.4.41 for comparison
+        uses: docker/build-push-action@c3c9e263c25d99ce0380d002d59b67737d91b0dc # v7.4.0
+        with:
+          context: upstream
+          file: upstream/Dockerfile
+          platforms: linux/amd64
+          load: true
+          tags: 9router-upstream:ci
+          cache-from: type=gha,scope=upstream-0.4.41
+          cache-to: type=gha,scope=upstream-0.4.41,mode=max
+      - name: Build Wolfi image
+        uses: docker/build-push-action@c3c9e263c25d99ce0380d002d59b67737d91b0dc # v7.4.0
+        with:
+          context: upstream
+          file: Dockerfile
+          platforms: linux/amd64
+          load: true
+          tags: 9router-wolfi:ci
+          labels: org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}
+          cache-from: type=gha,scope=wolfi-0.4.41
+          cache-to: type=gha,scope=wolfi-0.4.41,mode=max
+      - name: Compare local image sizes
         run: |
-          docker buildx build --load --tag 9router-wolfi:ci \
-            --file Dockerfile \
-            --label org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/${{ github.repository }} \
-            --cache-from type=gha --cache-to type=gha,mode=max upstream
+          upstream=$(docker image inspect 9router-upstream:ci --format '{{.Size}}')
+          wolfi=$(docker image inspect 9router-wolfi:ci --format '{{.Size}}')
+          {
+            echo '## Image size comparison (linux/amd64)'
+            echo '| Image | Local unpacked size (bytes) |'
+            echo '| --- | ---: |'
+            echo "| Upstream Dockerfile, 0.4.41 | $upstream |"
+            echo "| Wolfi, 0.4.41 | $wolfi |"
+            echo
+            echo 'Both are rebuilt on this runner from the same upstream commit; caches are separate. Docker build summaries show duration and cache utilization. Results are not the published multi-platform images or upstream historical CI timings.'
+            echo 'Upstream release CI: https://github.com/decolua/9router/actions/runs/25841384476 (amd64 + arm64; historical logs expired).'
+          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
       - name: Smoke test exact image
         run: bash smoke-test.sh 9router-wolfi:ci
       - name: Scan image with Grype
@@ -55,14 +84,14 @@ jobs:
           path: grype-results.json
           if-no-files-found: error
       - name: Log in to GHCR
-        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
+        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/0.4.41'
         uses: docker/login-action@81c6f93d4bc991e510b342a00b419b3bb4efc5c6 # v4.7.0
         with:
           registry: ghcr.io
           username: ${{ github.actor }}
           password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
       - name: Publish tested image
-        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
+        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/0.4.41'
         env:
           REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
           REVISION: ${{ github.sha }}

@@ -33,7 +33,7 @@ COPY --from=builder /app/.next/standalone ./
 COPY --from=builder /app/open-sse ./open-sse
 COPY --from=builder /app/src/mitm ./src/mitm
 COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules/node-forge ./node_modules/node-forge
-COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules/next ./node_modules/next
+
 COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules/sql.js ./node_modules/sql.js
 COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules/node-machine-id ./node_modules/node-machine-id
 COPY --from=builder /opt/lazy-runtime/node_modules/. ./node_modules/

@@ -51,6 +51,13 @@ bash smoke-test.sh 9router-wolfi:local
 - Grype scans the exact image before publication and saves a JSON report as a
   workflow artifact. Vulnerability findings do not block publication; scanner
   errors do. The report includes fixed and unfixed findings.
+- Docker build summaries show duration and cache utilization for both the Wolfi
+  build and the pinned upstream Dockerfile, rebuilt for linux/amd64 on the same
+  runner with separate caches. The job summary compares unpacked local image
+  sizes. These are not historical upstream build times or compressed registry
+  sizes; cache state and build order can affect timings. The upstream release
+  run is https://github.com/decolua/9router/actions/runs/25841384476 (the
+  original release built both amd64 and arm64; its logs have expired).
 - Rebuilds refresh OS/npm dependency resolution, not upstream source or
   the pinned Wolfi base digest. Update the upstream ref, Dockerfile labels and
   README together to change the application version.
